notes:
Anivora 0.1.47 improves orientation, Schedule states, list menus and announcement history.

- Normal app screens stay in portrait despite Android auto-rotate. The player's fullscreen button can still enter landscape; leaving the player restores portrait.
- Schedule shows the green illustration when offline. A successfully loaded day with no releases shows “No Release Schedule” and its explanatory message.
- Loading Schedule shows a pulsing timeline skeleton that respects reduced-motion settings. Profile no longer displays the Local diagnostics entry.
- Outlined bookmark icons now include the inset horizontal minus throughout the app.
- Add to My List uses a taller bottom sheet. Its light background dim fades independently while the sheet moves; other menus retain their existing backdrop behavior.
- Manual admin announcements are saved in notification history, reopen their full message and safe action link, and remain available offline within the existing history limit. Clearing history preserves deduplication so old announcements do not reappear on refresh.
- Notification backup/restore supports announcements and their deduplication history.
- File Backup now offers full ZIP, MAL ZIP and URL-list export. The legacy JSON export and paste link are removed.
- Token dialogs use stable input sizing and avoid applying Android keyboard resizing twice.
- Admin announcement removal deletes the selected server record. Already delivered app copies remain in local history until the user clears them.

Package: com.brandon300.anivora. Android version code: 49. ARM64 release using the existing signing certificate to update the installed app without uninstalling.

Source commit: https://github.com/brandon-300/Anivora/commit/429166af79f989fc5236ba64816791cf0abc0616

APK SHA-256: `dc0962807ceef8c847d8a46186c6a586ada26bf5bd67e88e13f60690ca9d9beb`

Verified: original package and signing certificate; non-debuggable ARM64 release; 16 KB alignment; portrait MainActivity manifest; exact compiled source and bundled APK match across 171 files; 70 native release unit tests; TypeScript; lint; 399 app tests; 18 Expo Doctor checks; Expo dependency compatibility; 212 Discord tests; five native Cloudflare runtime tests; 43 support-site tests. Browser checks cover schedule loading/offline/empty states, list menus, saved announcements, backup choices and both token dialogs.

Built locally. Prior Android 14 emulator evidence includes 29 native integration tests, ten player UI checks and six updater scenarios for release 0.1.46; these were not rerun against this release, whose application inputs differ. Browser viewport tests do not establish behavior of the physical Android keyboard. Physical Infinix Hot 50i/XOS, orientation gestures and Cast receiver playback remain untested here. Provider availability depends on the upstream service and network. Chainsaw Man Chapter 1 black-and-white WeebCentral artwork is upstream content and remains unchanged. Existing notification history remains capped at 100 entries.
